mu_name_from: AccessModel(MODEL_UNICON, L"Data\\Skill\\", L"Rider", 1) (ZzzOpenData.cpp:4204), so Data/Skill/Rider01.bmd; its sheets come from Data/Item (unicon.OZJ, unicon01.OZT). The ridden figure only: the bag item and the drop are Helper03.bmd. GOBoid.cpp creates it for a player whose helper is ITEM_HORN_OF_UNIRIA.
profile_note: A creature on its own rig, seen at the character's size under him: the monster profile and its 3x cap.
rig_from: 24 bones and four actions: 0 idle (6 keys), 1 (6 keys, never played for Uniria), 2 the run (7 keys, LockPositions), 3 the attack (6 keys). GOBoid.cpp:525-595 picks 2 while the rider moves, 3 while he attacks, 0 otherwise; it asks for 6 when he casts PLAYER_SKILL_RIDER, which this model does not have, and SetAction returns early for an action past NumActions (ZzzAI.cpp:424), so the horse holds what it was playing. Velocity 0.34 for every action (GOBoid.cpp:596).
scale_from: 0.9 at CreateMount (GOBoid.cpp:111-114), overwritten to 1.0 each frame by RenderMount (:684-691); drawn at 1.0. No bone link: it copies the rider's position and angle (:515, :524), the seat is in the player's ride clips.
sheet_from: Data/Item/unicon.OZJ (128x128, opaque: the hide, the horn, the saddle and a riveted plate) and unicon01.OZT (32x32 with alpha: the white mane and tail, cut away 24%, and a brown strap), from MuMain's own bin/Data.
tiled_why: The mane is alpha cards, and the Imp showed what the baked atlas does to them: packed flush against an opaque island, the card's edge samples its neighbour's alpha. Tiled keeps unicon01 its own sheet, cut by its own alpha.
sheet_materials_from: One material a sheet when tiled. unicon is mostly the hide, so fur; the horn, saddle and plate on it take fur too, which is a first pass (judge in the bench). unicon01 is the mane: hair.
cutout_from: unicon01.OZT carries alpha that cuts away 24%: the mane's edge is its alpha.
stats_note: No item row: this is the ridden figure, never a drop or a bag item. The row is Helper03's (13/2).
